claims: EVM wallets are a direct onboarding path
Email and Social Wallets are supported
Email/Social wallets are secured by Privy
Each new account is automatically credited with $1,000,000 test USDC shortly after creation
EVM signatures use personal_sign over SIWE messages
Subkeys still authenticate via v1 auth flow

local_v1_probe.onboarding_message: account creation requires at least 0.001 ETH or 5 USDC on Ethereum, Arbitrum, or Base

evidence: code-samples README still describes deterministic generation of a Paradex/L2 private key from an Ethereum private key
official samples still call /onboarding and /auth in v1-style flows
paradex-py still centers Paradex/L2 private key and subkey usage in account classes and examples

conclusion: Paradex currently offers a materially smoother retail onboarding surface than the first-pass conclusion suggested, thanks to direct EVM SIWE onboarding and Privy-backed email/social wallets. But a cold API-first wallet still appears gated by account initialization and minimum external chain balance, and official integrator code remains biased toward the older L2-private-key flow.
